# Gaps between Chapter 3's thrown types (003-failures.md#thrown-types, with
# Appendix E and throws.json) and the compiler for web globals whose
# declaration depends on the project's lib and types, found by
# FuzzLibOriginThrows. TypeScript selects @types/node's or workers-types'
# btoa, atob and structuredClone over lib.dom.d.ts's when both are loaded.
# A key names the contract (a lib row such as btoa@lib.dom.d.ts, or an
# untagged package), whether the callee is called, passed to map or called
# in a literal passed to map, and the host.
# target             key                                            owner     what is missing
FuzzLibOriginThrows  @types/node/call/effectful                     compiler  VIP-4: Chapter 3 gives an untagged @types/node declaration thrown type unknown, so btoa(s) or atob(s) in a plain function whose return type is wholly effectful is EK0401; the compiler treats @types/node callees as throwing never and reports nothing
FuzzLibOriginThrows  @types/node/call/effect                        compiler  VIP-4: Chapter 3 gives an untagged @types/node declaration thrown type unknown, so btoa(s) or atob(s) in effect code is EK0403; the compiler treats @types/node callees as throwing never and reports nothing
FuzzLibOriginThrows  @types/node/callback/effectful                 compiler  VIP-4: [s, s].map(btoa) with only @types/node's btoa rethrows unknown (Appendix E: map is @rethrows callbackfn), so it is EK0401 in a plain function whose return type is wholly effectful; the compiler reports nothing
FuzzLibOriginThrows  @types/node/callback/effect                    compiler  VIP-4: [s, s].map(btoa) with only @types/node's btoa rethrows unknown (Appendix E: map is @rethrows callbackfn), so it is EK0403 in effect code; the compiler reports nothing
FuzzLibOriginThrows  @cloudflare/workers-types/callback/effectful   compiler  VIP-4: [s, s].map(btoa) with workers-types' untagged btoa rethrows unknown (Appendix E: map is @rethrows callbackfn), so it is EK0401 in a plain function whose return type is wholly effectful; the compiler reports the direct call but not the passed one
FuzzLibOriginThrows  @types/node/literal/effectful                  compiler  VIP-4: [s, s].map((x) => btoa(x)) with @types/node's btoa: Chapter 3 says calls in a literal passed to a @rethrows parameter belong to the enclosing call, so the map call throws unknown and is EK0401 in a plain function whose return type is wholly effectful; the compiler reports nothing
FuzzLibOriginThrows  @types/node/literal/effect                     compiler  VIP-4: [s, s].map((x) => btoa(x)) with @types/node's btoa throws unknown through the literal (Chapter 3), so it is EK0403 in effect code; the compiler reports nothing
FuzzLibOriginThrows  @cloudflare/workers-types/literal/effectful    compiler  VIP-4: [s, s].map((x) => btoa(x)) with workers-types' untagged btoa throws unknown through the literal (Chapter 3), so it is EK0401 in a plain function whose return type is wholly effectful; the compiler reports the direct call but not the call in the literal
FuzzLibOriginThrows  @cloudflare/workers-types/literal/effect       compiler  VIP-4: [s, s].map((x) => btoa(x)) with workers-types' untagged btoa throws unknown through the literal (Chapter 3), so it is EK0403 in effect code; the compiler reports the direct call but not the call in the literal
FuzzLibOriginThrows  @cloudflare/workers-types/callback/effect      compiler  VIP-4: [s, s].map(btoa) with workers-types' untagged btoa rethrows unknown (Appendix E: map is @rethrows callbackfn), so it is EK0403 in effect code; the compiler reports the direct call but not the passed one
FuzzLibOriginThrows  corpus:dom-node-btoa-conditional-effectful     compiler  VIP-4: minimized reproduction of @types/node/call/effectful, the OAuth client's conditional btoa
FuzzLibOriginThrows  corpus:node-atob-map-effect                    compiler  VIP-4: minimized reproduction of @types/node/callback/effect
FuzzLibOriginThrows  corpus:workers-btoa-map-effectful              compiler  VIP-4: minimized reproduction of @cloudflare/workers-types/callback/effectful
FuzzLibOriginThrows  corpus:workers-btoa-literal-effect             compiler  VIP-4: minimized reproduction of @cloudflare/workers-types/literal/effect
FuzzLibOriginThrows  corpus:node-structuredclone-literal-effectful  compiler  VIP-4: minimized reproduction of @types/node/literal/effectful
